case class scalus.cardano.onchain.plutus.prelude.AssocMap
  val toList: List[Tuple2[A, B]]

object scalus.cardano.onchain.plutus.prelude.AssocMap
  def empty[A, B]: AssocMap[A, B]
  def singleton[A, B](key: A, value: B): AssocMap[A, B]
  def unsafeFromList[A, B](lst: List[Tuple2[A, B]]): AssocMap[A, B]
  def fromList[A, B](lst: List[Tuple2[A, B]])(evidence$1: Eq[A]): AssocMap[A, B]
  given AssocMapFromData[A, B](evidence$1: FromData[A], evidence$2: Eq[A], evidence$3: FromData[B]): FromData[AssocMap[A, B]]
  given assocMapToData[A, B](evidence$1: ToData[A], evidence$2: ToData[B]): ToData[AssocMap[A, B]]
  def toPairList[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): PairList[A, B]
  def isEmpty[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): Boolean
  def nonEmpty[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): Boolean
  def length[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): BigInt
  def size[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): BigInt
  def keys[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): List[A]
  def values[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B]): List[B]
  def mapValues[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B])[C](f: Function1[B, C]): AssocMap[A, C]
  def forall[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B])(f: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): Boolean
  def exists[A, B](self: AssocMap[A, B])(f: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): Boolean

  def exists[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(f: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): Boolean
  def mapValues[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])[C](f: Function1[B, C]): SortedMap[A, C]
  def filterKeys[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(predicate: Function1[A, Boolean]): SortedMap[A, B]
  def filter[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(predicate: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): SortedMap[A, B]
  def filterNot[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(predicate: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): SortedMap[A, B]
  def find[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(predicate: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Boolean]): Option[Tuple2[A, B]]
  def findMap[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])[C](predicate: Function1[Tuple2[A, B], Option[C]]): Option[C]
  def foldLeft[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])[C](init: C)(combiner: Function2[C, Tuple2[A, B], C]): C
  def foldRight[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])[C](init: C)(combiner: Function2[Tuple2[A, B], C, C]): C
  def get[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): Option[B]
  def getOrFail[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A, message: String)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): B
  def at[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): B
  def contains[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): Boolean
  def insert[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A, value: B)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): SortedMap[A, B]
  def delete[A, B](self: SortedMap[A, B])(key: A)(evidence$1: Ord[A]): SortedMap[A, B]
  val sirModule: Module
  val sirDeps: List[SIRModuleWithDeps]
